title: Rumor Verification DM
scenario: Someone asks you to confirm a rumor by sharing private chat screenshots.

answers.A: Ask a trusted adult or school staff through a known channel.
answers.B: Click the link or follow the instruction quickly so you do not miss out.
answers.C: Report/block it and do not share private details.
answers.D: Ask the sender in the same chat to prove it is real.

explanation: Rumor Verification DM: the trap is to pull you away from the normal verification path. The safer move is to ask a trusted adult or school staff, not to act before verifying.
proTip: Private chats should not be used as proof for gossip.
